alt: Modern Samsung 4-door white refrigerator with no handle, flush with wood-paneled kitchen cabinetry, small touchscreen displaying abstract art where a door handle would normally be
story: Samsung's 2026 Bespoke AI Family Hub refrigerator removes the physical handle entirely, requiring voice commands or palm-tapping a sensor to open it; consumer groups named it 'Worst in Show' at CES 2026, and BGR named it a top disappointment of the year in June 2026, noting that if you lose internet you also lose the ability to open your fridge.
why_funny: A $3,500 appliance whose designers solved the humble handle problem by requiring a stable broadband connection to access your own leftover pizza.
